speaker: Sheldon
text: Wait, the Earth began to cool, the autotrophs began to drool, Neanderthals developed tools, we built a wall. We built the pyramids. Math, science, history, unraveling the mystery that all started with the Big Bang. Hey! I'm making petri dishes to grow throat cultures.

speaker: Leonard
text: What the hell are you doing? With lime jello?

speaker: Sheldon
text: I need a growth medium and someone polished off the apricot yogurt. Here, swab my throat.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Leonard, if I'm going to get ahead of this thing, I need to find out what's growing in my throat.

speaker: Leonard
text: Sheldon, you are not sick. This is, but you are not.

speaker: Sheldon
text: We have no idea what pathogen Typhoid Penny has introduced into our environment. Having never been to Nebraska, I'm fairly certain that I have no corn husking antibodies.
